title: Coskeleton comparison under a local matching surjection
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site, let $n\geq1$, and let $f:L\to K$ be a morphism of simplicial presheaves of sets [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object]. Assume $L_i\to K_i$ is an isomorphism for $i<n$, $L_n\to K_n$ becomes surjective after sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], and both $L$ and $K$ are $n$-coskeletal (the canonical morphisms $L\to\operatorname{cosk}_n\operatorname{sk}_nL$ and $K\to\operatorname{cosk}_n\operatorname{sk}_nK$ of [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-coskeleton] are isomorphisms). Then for any commutative ring $R$, $f$ induces an isomorphism on every homology sheaf of the alternating-face complexes of free $R$-module sheaves on $L$ and $K$.

source.place: Hypercoverings, Lemma Tag 01GD (label lemma-acyclicity), lines 662-715. Proof route: replace K_n by the image of L_n and coskeletonize; finite-limit descriptions of coskeleta and exact sheafification identify the associated sheaf with K in every degree. Objectwise the resulting degree-n map is surjective, so the simplicial map is a trivial Kan fibration by the coskeleton lifting criterion. Its simplicial homotopy inverse induces a chain homotopy inverse on free R-modules. The free-R variant uses the same simplicial homotopy.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-image-coskeleton-factorization] to obtain M and a factorization f=p;q, with p(V) an objectwise trivial Kan fibration and every sheafified q_i invertible. The auxiliary theorem constructs the image truncation and coskeleton and proves all these properties; no new unproved obligation is introduced.

proof.text: The free-forgetful module adjunction makes ModuleCat.free R preserve sheafification equivalences, by Sheaf.preservesSheafification_of_adjunction. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-free-module-sheaf-sheafify-first] degreewise to q. Thus the termwise free-module sheaf morphism induced by q is an isomorphism of simplicial objects, and its alternating-face homology maps are isomorphisms.

proof.text: For each site object V apply [lem-weil-pbc-trivial-kan-homotopy-equivalence] to p(V), giving a section g and a homotopy id ~ p(V);g. Convert the cylinder homotopy to SimplicialObject.Homotopy, whisker it by ModuleCat.free R and apply toChainHomotopy. The resulting homology equality, together with g;p(V)=id and functoriality, gives two inverse homology maps over R. This is the Mathlib implementation of [lem-weil-pbc-simplicial-homotopy-free-chain-homotopy].

proof.text: Use HomologicalComplex.quasiIso_iff_evaluation to infer that the alternating-face complex map of free module presheaves induced by p is a quasi-isomorphism. AlgebraicTopology.map_alternatingFaceMapComplex identifies evaluation and sheafification of the alternating-face map with the alternating-face map of their images. Exact module sheafification preserves quasi-isomorphisms by [lem-weil-pbc-site-module-presheaf-sheafification-exact], implemented by quasiIsoAt_map_of_preservesHomology. Thus the free-module sheaf homology maps of p are invertible. Finally rewrite f=p;q and use preservation of composition to obtain the conclusion.

split_report.summary: Split along Stacks 01GD (hypercovering.tex 662-715), read with 01GC, Simplicial 0183/0185 (coskeleta as finite limits), 01A6 (coskeletal criterion), 08NL/08NS/08NM (trivial Kan fibrations), 019S/019Y (homotopies to chain homotopies) and Sites 00WJ/00WN, Modules on Sites 03AB/03AC. Steps: construct K' = cosk_n of the image truncation and the factorisation f = q o f'; q is a degreewise isomorphism after sheafification (mono+epi of sheaves, sheafification preserves the finite limits giving the coskeleton terms); hence the free R-module sheaf complexes of K' and K are isomorphic (03AC with R); objectwise f' is a trivial Kan fibration (01A6), so has a section that is a homotopy inverse (08NS), giving a chain homotopy equivalence of free R-module complexes (Mathlib SSet.Homotopy.chainComplexMap); homology presheaves are objectwise and sheafification commutes with homology. Statement kept (n >= 1 as stated; the proof works for n >= 0). Stacks writes (K'_m)^# = K_m where K_m^# is meant. Eight new nodes: three Mathlib leaves (sheaves of sets balanced; R-module presheaf sheafification exact; free chain homotopy from simplicial homotopy), a definition leaf (trivial Kan fibration = I.rlp), four unsplit (coskeleton finite-limit formula with preservation, 03AC with R, 01A6, 08NS). LeanSearch returned HTTP 500 throughout; recorded, with LeanFinder, Loogle and grep for each new node.
split_report.blueprint: The blueprint node lem-weil-pbc-hypercover-free-resolution proves exactness in its proof, first paragraph ('Exactness is a local assertion ... Thus every cycle is locally a boundary') by a local cone construction; the DAG's split of it replaces this by the Stacks coskeleton induction, of which this item is the inductive comparison step (its step 2, 'Thus [this node] identifies all free-module homology sheaves of K^n and K^{n-1}'). The steps here realize that comparison: steps 1-3 the passage to the image coskeleton (local surjectivity of the matching map, the blueprint's 'supplies a simplex with exactly those faces after an etale cover'), steps 4-6 the objectwise filling (the blueprint's cone/filling of simplices with given faces, here as the trivial Kan lifting) and the chain homotopy ('the alternating-face formula gives dh+hd=1').
